context:
Goal: the page keeps one store of its data, in git, with no copy step and no lag (your ruling R28).
Why yours: adding a connector needs your claude.ai login, and no session tool adds one (measured 2026-11-12, ListConnectors at 12:03 and 12:08 CST lists no GitHub connector for this account).
What you already have: the GitHub integration is connected (you said so at 12:07 CST, and cloud sessions use it to reach repos). That integration is not a connector, and a page can only call connectors.
Steps: open https://claude.ai/settings/connectors, look in the directory for a GitHub connector, add it, sign in, and give it the shivinate7/claude-settings repository. Then press Done here. If the directory has no GitHub connector, say so here instead.
What happens next: a probe lane measures whether a page can write git through it (from your phone too, with or without a prompt per write, and how often writes fail). If there is no such connector, the probe tests your own small site that holds a token, or a page that asks Claude to write git for it.

lastAnswer.note: Custom connectors are not allowed -- so we can do route B

ref: decision waiting-page-one-store; step page-git-connector-probe; step page-data-one-store
reply: Closed with your 12:10 CST ruling, relayed by the coordinator: no connector; the page moves to route B, your own small site that holds a token. The page-data lane rewrites decision waiting-page-one-store to route B and sends new steps.
short: Add a GitHub connector (not the integration)
title: Add a GitHub connector from the claude.ai connector directory, so the page can store its data in git
why: The probe step waits on this connector; it is the first of nine steps toward one store for page data.
